label: WITTGENSTEINIAN_FIDEISM_2 in its sharp form does not hold of the Catholic practice: it misdescribes…
paraphrase: Wittgensteinian fideism in its sharp form (internal grammar together with the cut-off thesis) does not hold of the Catholic practice: it misdescribes that practice. It says nothing about other practices or about weaker fideist proposals such as Phillips's later view or religious minimalism.
